description: Full-text search of the store catalog by words, SKU, brand or part number. Returns up to 20 matches with price, availability state and the product page link. For one person's question, not for copying the catalog. Use orderable_only=true to skip items that cannot be bought now.

brand.description: brand name to restrict to, e.g. Schlage

categoryId.description: category id, as in the category tree, to restrict to

offset.description: offset for the next page, default 0

orderableOnly.description: true = only items that can be ordered now

query.description: words, SKU or manufacturer part number

name: search_products
title: Search products
